<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-04-0419-58-42" status="unreviewed">dang po ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha 1</rs> na re skad 1 1 <gis> stong ba 'gyur med du 'dzin pa myong ba'i rang rig gis blo 'gyur med 'dzin byed du dngos su grub |
             yul 'gyur med kyi rnam par shugs la grub cing dgag bya'i chos 'dzin gyi tshad mas don byed pa 2 ka 'gyur bar grub pas de 2 kyis skad 
               <lb n="60b5"/>1 gis stong ba la don byed pa 2 kyis stong pa'i phyogs chos grub gsung pa la | 
               
               1 grub pas 'gyur ba tsam rnam bcad la khegs pa na don byed pa 2 po yang khegs so zhes zer ba 
                      
               de mi rigs te dgag gzhu 'i steng du dgag bya 'gog yang la de tshad mas grub dgos na snang ba tsam po la bden dngos mi khegs par 'gyur |</seg></TEI>
